statuses.description: The states an operator can be in. Paused statuses with a timeout turn overtime, and can send the agent back to Available on their own.
statuses.emptyHint: Add the first status your operators can pick.
statuses.autoReturn: Return to Available when the timeout ends
statuses.autoReturnHint: Only applies when a timeout is set.
statuses.systemNote: The dialer sets this status itself, so its type is fixed and operators cannot pick it.
statuses.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will no longer be offered to operators.
statuses.protected: Default and system statuses cannot be deleted

dispositions.description: The outcomes an operator records after each call. The first nine get the hotkeys 1-9 in the workspace.
dispositions.emptyHint: Operators need at least one disposition to close a call.
dispositions.scheduleCallbackHint: The operator must pick a callback date and time.
dispositions.addToDncHint: The number goes on the do-not-call list.
dispositions.deleteBody: "{{name}}" disappears from the workspace. Past calls keep their code.

dnc.importDescription: One number per line, or a CSV whose first column is the phone number. A header row is ignored.

dnc.readError: The file could not be read
